# `@sackville/mutate` test fixtures

Golden reports the pure summarizer/parsers are tested against. No real mutation tool
runs in `pnpm gate` — these are captured once, out-of-gate, and committed.

- **`mutation-report.json`** — a Stryker `mutation-testing-elements` report
  (`schemaVersion`, `files[path].mutants[].status`), consumed by `summarizeMutation`.

- **`mutmut-results.txt`** — `mutmut results --all true` output captured from **mutmut
  3.5.0**, consumed by `parseMutmutResults`. One line per mutant
  (`<module>.x_<fn>__mutmut_<n>: <status>`).

- **`cosmic-ray-dump.jsonl`** — `cosmic-ray dump <session.sqlite>` JSON-lines consumed by
  `parseCosmicRayDump`. Each line is `[work_item, work_result | null]`. The **structure was
  captured from a real `cosmic-ray` 8.4.6 run** (`init`/`exec`/`dump` over a 3-function
  `calc.py` with tests covering only two of them): note `module_path`/`operator_name`/
  `start_pos: [line, col]` live nested under `work_item.mutations[]`, and a `work_result`
  carries `worker_outcome` + (when `normal`) `test_outcome`. The verbose `output`/`diff`
  fields (full pytest text + absolute paths) are pruned — the parser never reads them. The
  first two records (`killed`, `survived`) are real, pruned; the remaining records are
  hand-authored using the same authentic structure to exercise the rarer `worker_outcome`/
  `test_outcome` enum values (`no_test` → NoCoverage, `incompetent` → RuntimeError,
  `exception` → RuntimeError, `skipped` → Ignored, a `null` result → Pending, and an
  unrecognized outcome → Pending) which a small clean run won't naturally produce. To
  re-capture the real shape: `uv pip install cosmic-ray pytest`, then `cosmic-ray init
  cr.toml session.sqlite && cosmic-ray exec cr.toml session.sqlite && cosmic-ray dump
  session.sqlite`.

- **`cosmic-ray-scoped-dump.jsonl`** — a REAL `cosmic-ray dump` from a **diff-SCOPED**
  cosmic-ray 8.4.6 run (`module-path = ["pkg/calc.py", "pkg/strutil.py"]`), exec'd, dumped,
  then pruned of the verbose `output`/`diff` fields. `calc.py` is covered (22 mutants, all
  `killed`); `strutil.py` has no test (11 mutants, all `survived` — without coverage-guided
  execution an uncovered mutant just survives the passing suite, a real gap → warn). Drives the
  `reconcileScope` + `runCosmicRay` wiring tests: both selected files appear in the summary, so
  reconciliation passes. Provenance: see the **SLICE 0** facts below.

- **`mutmut-scoped-results.txt`** — a REAL `mutmut results --all true` from a diff-SCOPED
  mutmut 3.5.0 run (`paths_to_mutate = ["pkg/calc.py", "pkg/strutil.py"]`, the rest of the
  package `also_copy`'d so the unscoped tests still import). `calc` mutants `killed`, `strutil`
  mutants `no tests` (NoCoverage — mutmut's stats pass detects uncovered mutants). Confirms the
  `<dotted.module>.x_<fn>__mutmut_<n>: <status>` line format is unchanged in 3.5.0.

## SLICE 0 — empirical tool-fact capture (ADR 0010 addendum 2, 2026-06-05)

Captured once from **cosmic-ray 8.4.6** + **mutmut 3.5.0** (provisioned via `uv` in a reference
env; the tools are NOT in the dev container, per the addendum-1 / LSP fixture convention). These
are the ground-truth facts the (staged) config emitters are pinned to — **never doc-derived guesses**.

**cosmic-ray 8.4.6:**
- `module-path` accepts **either a single string OR a list of file paths**. A file list scopes
  `init` to exactly those files (verified: `["pkg/calc.py","pkg/geo.py"]` → only those two files'
  work items; a single string `"pkg/calc.py"` → that one file). **⇒ Fork A holds; the Fork A2
  `excluded-modules`-subtraction fallback is NOT needed.**
- `excluded-modules` accepts **exact paths AND fnmatch globs** and **subtracts** matching files
  from the `module-path` scope (verified: `excluded-modules=["pkg/geo.py"]` and `["*/geo.py"]`
  both removed geo from a calc+geo scope). **⇒ blocker #3 is real: a blind-copied inherited
  exclusion that matches a selected file silently under-scopes — the emitter must reconcile, not
  copy blind.**
- Config: `[cosmic-ray]` `{ module-path, timeout (float), excluded-modules (list), test-command }`
  + `[cosmic-ray.distributor] { name }`. Generated by `cosmic-ray new-config`. The dump shape is
  unchanged under scoping; `summary.files[]` is keyed by `module_path` = a **path** (`pkg/calc.py`).

**mutmut 3.5.0 — the design's Fork B assumption was WRONG (slice 0 caught it):**
- The path-scoping key is **`paths_to_mutate`** (a list of file/dir paths). There is **NO
  `only_mutate` and NO `source_paths`** in 3.5.0 (confirmed by reading `Config`/`load_config` in
  the installed `mutmut/__main__.py`). The exclusion key is **`do_not_mutate`** (a list of
  `fnmatch` globs, via `Config.should_ignore_for_mutation`). **⇒ the emitter must scope via
  `paths_to_mutate`, not the doc-derived `source_paths`+`only_mutate`. (Fork F: emit only these
  slice-0-verified keys.)**
- Config is read from `pyproject.toml [tool.mutmut]` (tomllib) or `setup.cfg [mutmut]`.
- **Scoping a SUBSET breaks the baseline:** mutmut copies only `paths_to_mutate` files into its
  `mutants/` sandbox, so a test importing an unscoped sibling module fails collection ("failed to
  collect stats" → mutants `not checked`). **Fix: `also_copy` the rest of the package** so imports
  resolve while only `paths_to_mutate` is mutated (verified). ⇒ the emitter runs in a **fresh
  sandbox cwd** (the `mutants/` cache is sticky) and needs a baseline-smoke gate.
- **Fork B2 — seen-vs-unseen is INDISTINGUISHABLE:** a scoped file with **zero mutable code**
  leaves **no trace** in `mutmut results --all true` (verified: `paths_to_mutate` including a
  comment-only `nomut.py` produced no `nomut` line at all). ⇒ `reconcileScope` for mutmut is the
  **conservative** variant: throw inconclusive on ANY selected file that yields 0 mutants (some
  false-inconclusive, zero false-pass). NB the mutmut summary is keyed by **dotted module**
  (`pkg.calc`), not path, so the runner maps selected paths → modules before reconciling.
